{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, we appreciate that you elected to appear before us, without being subpoenaed by writ.|Unidentified Chief Justice|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Chief Justice]] and the head of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]]<ref name="CoD" /> as of [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> The Chief Justice heard the corruption [[Supreme Court inquiry against Finis Valorum|case]] against [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] brought by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], the chair of the [[Internal Activities Committee]].<ref name="CoD" />
